notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake
When Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
